verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Expensify has an API with OAuth2 credential/token flow for acting on behalf of users, but there is no documentation or claim that the API exposes the full breadth of UI capabilities (workspace configuration, travel booking, invoicing, card limits, SmartScan review, etc.) — the probe also shows a broken docs endpoint. missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints covering workspace/rule configuration, travel, invoicing, card management, and any independent confirmation of full UI/API parity.
